what: When you hover a menu item, its letters (.04s apart, one by one) slide up −75% while shrinking to 0 scale and vanish (.45s power2.out), then .15s later the same letters pop up from +75% below at 0 scale and settle in place. At the front of the incoming side, a small dark square outside the left of the text pops out first to mark the menu item currently pointed at. When you move away, the same timeline rewinds — an interaction that shows ‹pointing› without color on a neutral header line

options.lag: Delay before the incoming line starts after the outgoing line (seconds), default .15
options.to: Text that swaps in on hover (same text if empty) — a swap like ”Contact” → ”Copied”
options.mark: If off, text only with no box marker
options.--fx-mark: Square side length (css), default .66em — original 12px (at a 12px font size)
options.--fx-mark-gap: Gap between square and text (css), default 4px
options.[data-fx-part=label]: (If present) child holding the text — for when the button also contains an icon
options.tap: When on, touch devices also spin on press like the interaction response, and pressing elsewhere rewinds (imitating mobile browser mouseenter), default off
options.tap-from: Narrowest window width (px) at which tap is enabled, default 0

from.where: shared.js header Index·Contact Us·language buttons, Contact Section mail·phone copy buttons (no indicator) — original FlipHoverButton (.45s power2.out · stagger .04 · enters after .15s · data-flip-mark square)

note: On devices with no pointer and with reduced motion, text is not swapped, only the box lights up on focus
